text:
Alex: Hey team — opened a small PR that tweaks the VPC ACL for the GPU subnet to lock down wide access. This is blocking the gpu-pool lockdown rollout, can someone take a quick look? PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/482

Maria: Linking the PR — quick question: is this a hard deny for 0.0.0.0/0 or scoped to specific ports? Need to make sure monitoring + bastion still work.

Alex: It's a deny for inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on the GPU subnet, but we allow the bastion CIDR and monitoring IPs in the same change. Plan snippet below — will also add a short migration note in the PR.
```hcl
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "deny_public_inbound_gpu" {
  network_acl_id = aws_network_acl.gpu.id
  rule_number    = 100
  egress         = false
  protocol       = "-1"
  rule_action    = "deny"
  cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
}
```

Chen: Can you paste the `terraform plan` output for the affected resources (only the diff lines)? want to confirm no accidental replace of the GPU ENIs.

Alex: Pasted plan diff in the PR comments (shortened). It's only adding the ACL rule, no replacements expected.

Sam: @Alex thanks — quick note: we should ensure SSH from the ops-bastion and our Datadog healthcheck IPs are allowed. If those are explicitly whitelisted then :+1: from me. Also, does this need a canary rollout?

Alex: Yes, bastion CIDR and datadog IPs are whitelisted in the same file — included the CIDRs in the change. No canary needed for ACL-only change but we can do a staged apply to the non-prod first.

Maria: Please add a short test plan in the PR description (how to validate, rollback steps). Also tag @Sam for SRE approval.

infra-bot: CI / tf-lint: passed
infra-bot: CI / terraform-plan: success (no destroy operations)

Chen: Reviewed the plan — looks safe. Leaving a small nit about rule_number ordering but not blocking.

Sam: I'll run a quick smoke apply on the staging workspace in ~10m and verify monitoring + SSH. If green I'll approve.

Alex: Thanks — ping me if you see anything weird. If staging looks good I plan to merge in ~30m.

Sam: Staging apply started, monitoring checks are green so far.

Maria: Added test steps in PR and a rollback note.

Chen: :+1: from me, go ahead after SRE ack.

Sam: SRE ack — smoke passed. Approving now.

Alex: Great, thanks everyone — merging in 5m. Will post a short follow-up once the prod apply completes. :rocket:
